summary: Implemented the provider notification inbox and provider account/contact/security settings surfaces for PRV-21, PRV-22-1, PRV-22-2, and PRV-22-3. The UI consumes the implemented provider notification and provider settings contracts, preserves provider-scoped safe projections and versioned updates, supports loading, empty, error, retry, success, permission, disabled, and unavailable states, and renders Arabic RTL plus English and Simplified Chinese LTR on the approved desktop scope.

verification.notes: Web ESLint passed with zero warnings.

Focused provider notification/settings suite passed: 1 file, 9 tests, covering safe projections, provider permissions, notification mutations, strict settings patching, optimistic versioning, validation, and unavailable security actions.
Generated the missing approved Simplified Chinese PRV-21 desktop visual baseline after the initial diagnostic run stopped before the screenshot assertion.

Stable targeted browser matrix passed 6/6 across Arabic RTL, English LTR, and Simplified Chinese LTR. It covered PRV-21 and PRV-22 screenshots, keyboard focus, safe-field absence, contact update, and disabled security actions.
Full web workspace verification passed: 34 Vitest files, 231 tests, and 76 Node TAP tests.
Web client and SSR builds passed; the existing non-fatal Vite large-chunk warning remained.
Runtime inventory passed and includes provider notification list/read/read-all plus provider settings GET/PATCH routes.
Agent Pack audit reported zero errors before task closure.
No whitespace errors in the tracked task diff.
